disorder-name.detail: Patients with depression (DSM-IV diagnosis) in discovery and replication clinical cohorts.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs)... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two independent Chinese clinical datasets from Zhengzhou University and University of Electronic Science and Technology of China.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."

age.detail: Age values for the clinical cohort are not reported in the text; demographics noted only as being in Table 1.
age.supporting_text: "The clinical demographics were presented in Table 1. There was no significant difference in terms of age and sex between patients with depression and HCs in both datasets."

sex.detail: Sex counts/percentages for the clinical cohort are not reported in the text; demographics noted only as being in Table 1.
sex.supporting_text: "The clinical demographics were presented in Table 1. There was no significant difference in terms of age and sex between patients with depression and HCs in both datasets."
